description.zh-CN: 个人评分，1–10 分。1–2 一般，3–4 精选，5–6 精品，7–8 顶尖，9–10 经典；五颗星显示时半星代表 1 分。
description.en: Personal score from 1 to 10. Bands are 1–2 Basic, 3–4 Selected, 5–6 Premium, 7–8 Top and 9–10 Classic. In the five-star display, half a star equals one point.

description.zh-CN: 标记希望快速找回的影片，可从导航入口筛选，也可在卡片上直接切换。
description.en: Marks films for quick access through navigation and the card toggle.

description.zh-CN: 表示影片已经看完。播放结束时自动标为已看过；手动锁定时保留人工选择。
description.en: Indicates a film has been watched to the end. Set automatically when playback ends unless the value is manually locked.

description.zh-CN: 影片的显示标题；优先使用补全资料中的正式标题，也可以手动修改。
description.en: The display title, initialized from available metadata and editable manually.

description.zh-CN: 从路径或资料源提取并标准化的影片识别码，可用于搜索和查重。
description.en: A normalized identifier extracted from the file path or metadata, usable for search and duplicate matching.

description.zh-CN: 影片的简介或补充说明，支持手动录入及资料源补全。
description.en: A film synopsis or additional description, entered manually or enriched from metadata.

description.zh-CN: 影片的主展示图片。可选择本地图片，或采用资料源提供的海报。
description.en: The primary image, imported locally or obtained from a configured metadata source.

description.zh-CN: 影片列表中海报的展示方式。未设置时自动判断：宽高比接近 3:2 的海报视为影碟包装盒展开图（左侧 47.5% 为封底、中间 5% 为中脊、右侧 47.5% 为封面），以影碟-3D 展示；其他海报完整展示。
description.en: How the poster is shown in film lists. When unset, a poster close to 3:2 is treated as an unfolded disc case (left 47.5% back cover, middle 5% spine, right 47.5% front cover) and shown as a 3D disc case; other posters are shown whole.

description.zh-CN: 控制影片是否进入默认列表。隐藏只影响索引展示，不删除原文件。
description.en: Controls inclusion in the default catalog. Hiding a film never deletes its media file.

description.zh-CN: 引用具体人物；可选择或新建多个人物。性别、出生日期等资料记录在人物值实体上。
description.en: References individual people. Select or create people; gender and date of birth belong to each person value.

description.zh-CN: 影片的制作或发行机构，支持选择多个标签及创建新选项。
description.en: Production or distribution organizations, with multiple selection and option creation.

description.zh-CN: 用于影片、时间点、区间或标签值的主题分类。每个选项都有独立身份；引用其他标签值形成的关系不能包含环。
description.en: Topic classification for films, points, intervals and values. Each option has stable identity; value references must remain acyclic.

description.zh-CN: 媒体文件的实际位置。此处用于展示，文件访问始终以宿主记录的真实路径为准。
description.en: The actual media file location. File access always uses the host-owned path.

description.zh-CN: 文件占用的字节数，展示时自动换算为 KiB、MiB 或 GiB。
description.en: The file size in bytes, formatted automatically as KiB, MiB or GiB.

description.zh-CN: 影片首次加入本地影片库的时间。
description.en: When the film was first added to the local catalog.

description.zh-CN: 文件系统记录的最后修改时间，用于识别媒体文件变化。
description.en: The file modification time, used to detect media changes.

description.zh-CN: 媒体探测得到的总时长，以原始影片时间轴为准。
description.en: Total duration reported by the media probe on the original timeline.

description.zh-CN: 视频画面的水平像素数。
description.en: Horizontal pixel count of the video frame.

description.zh-CN: 视频画面的垂直像素数，用于展示清晰度及比较版本。
description.en: Vertical pixel count, used to display resolution and compare versions.

description.zh-CN: 媒体探测得到的每秒帧数，也用于逐帧播放的时间步进。
description.en: Frames per second reported by the media probe, also used for frame stepping.

description.zh-CN: 视频流使用的编码格式，例如 H.264 或 HEVC。
description.en: The video codec, such as H.264 or HEVC.

description.zh-CN: 音频流使用的编码格式；没有音轨时可能为空。
description.en: The audio codec. It may be absent when the file has no audio track.

description.zh-CN: 影片所属的本地影片库，用于跨库查询与分组。
description.en: The catalog library containing the film, usable for queries and grouping.

description.zh-CN: 具体人物的性别，未设置时保持未知。
description.en: Gender of an individual person; unset remains unknown.

description.zh-CN: 人物的出生日期，使用 YYYY-MM-DD。未知时留空，不另外维护会随时间变化的年龄。
description.en: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD. Leave unknown dates unset; age is not stored separately.

description.zh-CN: 影片的正式发行日期；可从本地资料文件读取，未知时留空。
description.en: Official release date, optionally read from a local sidecar. Leave unknown dates unset.

description.zh-CN: 影片导演，引用人物集合中的具体人物。
description.en: Directors of the film, referencing individuals in the people collection.

description.zh-CN: 影片所属系列；系列拥有独立身份，不以文件夹名称作为身份。
description.en: Series membership with independent identities rather than folder names.

description.zh-CN: 影片的语言信息，可包含多种语言。未知时不作推断。
description.en: Languages used in the film; multiple values are allowed. Unknown languages are not inferred.

description.zh-CN: 个人笔记，可记录整部影片、时间点或区间；自动补全不会覆盖笔记。
description.en: Personal notes for a film, point or interval. Enrichment does not overwrite notes.

description.zh-CN: 手动核对后填写 Q 开头的 Wikidata 标识。相同姓名不代表同一实体；补全仅使用此明确标识。
description.en: Enter a verified Wikidata Q ID. Equal names do not establish identity; enrichment uses this explicit identifier.

description.zh-CN: 该人物或厂牌的资料摘要；原始来源和核对记录保存在字段信息中。
description.en: A profile summary of this person or organization. Source evidence is retained in field information.

description.zh-CN: 该人物或厂牌的公开官方网站地址。
description.en: The public official website of this person or organization.

description.zh-CN: 人物肖像或厂牌标志。下载到本机资源存储，保留来源证据。
description.en: A portrait or organization logo, stored locally with source evidence.

description.zh-CN: 厂牌或组织的成立日期，未知时留空。
description.en: The date the organization was established; leave unknown dates unset.

description.zh-CN: 开启后按资料源声明的周期刷新，默认每天检查人物或厂牌资料及相关作品。新发现保留为待确认候选；仅应用运行且允许联网时执行。
description.en: Refreshes profiles and related works on the source schedule (daily by default). Discoveries remain reviewable candidates. Runs while the app is open and online access is enabled.

description.zh-CN: 作品在公开资料源中的稳定地址，可用于核对身份。
description.en: Stable public source address for verifying this work.

description.zh-CN: 公开来源提供的发行日期。未知的月日保持未填写。
description.en: Release date reported by the public source. Unknown month or day remains unset.

description.zh-CN: 由订阅或手动补全发现的作品。接受候选后保存为独立值实体，并保留来源链接和发行日期。
description.en: Works found through subscriptions or manual enrichment. Accept candidates to save independent entities with source links and release dates.

description.zh-CN: 从路径文本提取番号，统一字母、分隔符和数字位数。
description.en: Extract a catalog code and normalize letters, separators and numeric padding.

description.zh-CN: 使用已核对的实体 ID 补全公开资料。未填写 ID 时跳过；不按相同姓名自动合并实体。
description.en: Enrich public profiles using a verified entity ID. Skips subjects without an ID and never merges entities by name.

description.zh-CN: 使用已核对的 Wikidata ID 查询出演、执导或制作的作品，最多返回按发行日期排序的 100 项。候选只在确认后进入值实体集合，不创建本地影片或下载媒体。
description.en: Uses a verified Wikidata ID to find up to 100 works, ordered by release date, credited to this person or organization. Candidates enter the value collection only after review; no local films are created and no media is downloaded.

args.literal: } OPTIONAL { ?item wdt:P577 ?release } SERVICE wikibase:label { bd:serviceParam wikibase:language "zh,en". } } GROUP BY ?item ?itemLabel ORDER BY DESC(?date) LIMIT 100

text.zh-CN: 配置一个新的标签字段

description.zh-CN: 个人整理偏好的分类，可在其下声明其他个人属性。
description.en: Groups personal organization preferences and user-defined properties.

description.zh-CN: 描述影片内容与出版信息的属性分类。
description.en: Groups descriptive information about a film and its publication.

description.zh-CN: 从真实文件和媒体流读取的属性分类，展示值不会改变原文件。
description.en: Groups facts read from media files. Display values do not change the original file.

description.zh-CN: 人物标签的分类入口，子标签可以被主演等引用字段选用。
description.en: Groups person tags that can be referenced by fields such as cast.

description.zh-CN: 制作或发行机构的分类入口，其子标签可以作为厂牌选项。
description.en: Groups production and distribution organizations available as studio options.

description.zh-CN: 内容主题的分类入口，其子标签可作为影片的分类标签。
description.en: Groups topic tags used to categorize films.

description.zh-CN: 独立的人物值实体，可由主演、导演等字段共同引用，并标注人物资料。
description.en: Independent people shared by cast, director and other fields, with their own profile annotations.

description.zh-CN: 独立的制作及发行机构值实体。
description.en: Independent production and distribution organization values.

description.zh-CN: 独立的主题值实体，供分类与值之间的无环关联使用。
description.en: Independent topic values for classification and acyclic relationships between values.

description.zh-CN: 控制影片是否进入默认列表。隐藏只影响索引展示，不删除原文件。
description.en: Controls inclusion in the default catalog. Hiding a film never deletes its media file.

description.zh-CN: 影片列表中海报的展示方式。只改变展示，不修改海报图片。
description.en: Ways to show a poster in film lists. They change only the display, never the poster image.

description.zh-CN: 不裁切，按海报自身的宽高比完整展示。
description.en: Shows the whole poster at its own aspect ratio, without cropping.

description.zh-CN: 把海报当作影碟包装盒展开图，展示为略微侧转的立体包装盒，露出封面和少量中脊；鼠标悬停时转向封底。
description.en: Treats the poster as an unfolded disc case and shows a slightly turned 3D case with the front cover and part of the spine; hovering turns it to the back cover.

description.zh-CN: 把海报当作影碟包装盒展开图，只平面展示右侧的封面。
description.en: Treats the poster as an unfolded disc case and shows only its front cover (the right part) flat.

description.zh-CN: 把海报当作影碟包装盒展开图，只平面展示左侧的封底。
description.en: Treats the poster as an unfolded disc case and shows only its back cover (the left part) flat.

description.zh-CN: 可用于人物资料的性别选项。未标注表示未知。
description.en: Gender options for people. An unset annotation means unknown.

description.zh-CN: 具有稳定身份的影片系列。
description.en: Film series with stable identities.

description.zh-CN: 影片语言选项；可以扩充。
description.en: Extensible film language options.

description.zh-CN: 资料源返回的独立作品实体，使用外部稳定标识保持身份，不按同名合并，也不代表已拥有媒体文件。
description.en: Independent works returned by sources, identified by stable external IDs rather than names. These do not imply ownership of media files.
